centre_endorsements: Blue Dog Coalition co-chair (member); Problem Solvers Caucus member; WelcomePAC (2026 endorsement); Blue Dog Coalition (member); Problem Solvers Caucus (member)
rule: CI ≥ 5 and LI ≤ 3
rationale: Blue Dog co-chair, Problem Solvers member and WelcomePAC endorsee (C1 3) with fiscal, border, cultural, independence and business markers (CI about 8) and explicit rejection of 'Defund ICE' and Israel-aid conditions; no left markers. Clear Category 4.

name: Emily Randall
caucuses: Congressional Progressive Caucus member; New Democrat Coalition member
centre_endorsements: New Democrat Coalition (member)
rule: LI ≥ 6
rationale: LI about 5 (M4A, Melt ICE, DC statehood, trans-sports stance, Israel aid cut-off vote) against CI about 1 (New Dem); EPD 4 and no evidence of avoiding scrutiny (EO 3), so step 5 places her nearest Category 1 as an imperfect fit. Her 2024 pro-Israel statements and New Dem membership temper the call.

name: Pramila Jayapal
left_endorsements: Justice Democrats (listed among its current congressmembers, 2026 candidates page); Working Families Party (WFP Washington, 2026); Our Revolution ('Rep. Pramila Jayapal for re-election to Congress'); Progressive Change Campaign Committee (candidates page); Congressional Progressive Caucus (member)
rule: LI ≥ 6
rationale: Bulk cosponsorships (Ultra-Millionaire Tax, M4A as lead sponsor, GND, DC statehood, Block the Bombs) plus abolish-ICE and Court-expansion cosponsorships and Justice Democrats/WFP/Our Revolution backing give LI far above 6 with no centrist markers. Former CPC chair; core movement-left figure.

name: Kim Schrier
centre_endorsements: New Democrat Coalition (member)
rule: residual (credentialed and engaged): CI ≥ 3 and CI ≥ LI: leans centrist
rationale: LI about 1 (DC statehood) against CI about 3 (New Dem, Laken Riley vote, high Lugar bipartisanship rank). Credentialed (EPD 6) with no evidence of avoiding scrutiny (EO 3), so step 5 places her nearest Category 4 as an imperfect fit; thin evidence on her own statements.

name: Adam Smith
caucuses: Congressional Progressive Caucus member; New Democrat Coalition member
centre_endorsements: New Democrat Coalition (member)
rule: LI ≥ 6
rationale: Mechanically LI about 6 (Ultra-Millionaire Tax, M4A, GND, DC statehood, 2018 abolish-ICE cosponsorship, 2026 vote to end Israel military aid) with only New Dem membership on the centrist side, giving Category 1. Markers conflict with his long New Dem/defence-establishment profile and a 2026 primary challenge from the socialist left; the L9 marker rests on a 2018 cosponsorship, so confidence is low.

name: Marilyn Strickland
centre_endorsements: New Democrat Coalition leadership: Vice Chair & Whip (119th Congress); elected New Dem Vice Chair for Communications for the 120th Congress on 10 Nov 2026; New Democrat Coalition (member)
rule: residual (credentialed and engaged): CI ≥ 3 and CI ≥ LI: leans centrist
rationale: She is a pro-business New Democrat leader: former Chamber of Commerce CEO, endorsed by the U.S. Chamber and AIPAC, publicly backs funding police, and has almost no left markers (only DC statehood from bulk data). Her centrist index comes to about 3, below the Cat 4 threshold of 5. She lands in Cat 4 only through the step-5 tie-break (credentialed, engaged, CI > LI), so this is an imperfect fit. Her votes against Laken Riley, the trans-sports bill and the Nov 2025 CR keep her inside the party mainstream.

name: Mitchell Berman
centre_endorsements: Blue Dog PAC / Blue Dog Action (general-election endorsement); Blue Dog PAC; New Democrat Action Fund
rule: not 1/4; EPD ≤ 3
rationale: Union nurse running a mainstream labour-Democratic platform (public option, PRO Act) with Blue Dog and New Dem endorsements but no other centrist or left markers (LI 0, CI 3). With no prior office and modest policy depth (EPD 2), the rule gives Cat 2; small-dollar share is typical-to-high (0.37).

name: Mark Pocan
rule: LI ≥ 6
rationale: From bulk data he co-sponsors Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, DC statehood and Block the Bombs. His own record adds an abolish-ICE bill, opposition to restrictions on minors' gender care, an indefinite agribusiness merger moratorium, and a 2026 Our Revolution endorsement. That gives LI of about 8, well above the Cat 1 threshold, with no centrist markers. He is a former CPC co-chair and a long-standing movement-left figure, though he also engages opponents in open town halls.

name: Rebecca Cooke
left_endorsements: Bernie Sanders; Bernie Sanders (personal / Fighting Oligarchy)
centre_endorsements: Blue Dog PAC (endorsed; she pledges to join Blue Dog Coalition); WelcomePAC; Third Way (former fellow); Blue Dog PAC; New Democrat Action Fund; WelcomePAC (Win the Middle slate)
rule: CI ≥ 5 and LI ≤ 3
rationale: Explicitly self-identified centrist and prospective Blue Dog who opposes M4A, defund-the-police and abolish-ICE and criticises her party as too far left (CI ~7). Some populist economic positions and a Sanders endorsement (LI ~1) do not approach the left threshold.

name: Gwen Moore
rule: residual (credentialed and engaged): LI ≥ 4 and LI > CI: leans left
rationale: She is a long-serving CPC member with a progressive voting record, but few movement-left markers: GND co-sponsorship and DC statehood from bulk data, plus trans-sports inclusion. That puts LI at about 3, short of the Cat 1 threshold of 6. She is not a 119th Medicare for All or Block the Bombs co-sponsor and beat a DSA-member challenger from her left. She is credentialed (EPD 6) and EO scores a neutral 3 on unverified debates, so the step-5 tie-break (LI > CI = 0) puts her in Cat 1, an imperfect fit. If she in fact skipped debates (EO ≤ 2) she would fall to Cat 3.
